name: Day AI
description: Day AI is an AI-Native CRM that transforms emails, chats and meetings into richly-structured CRM data, stored in an LLM-optimized format for seamless and deep, relevant context retrieval. Use this Connector to give Claude direct access to your richly-structured customer data, enabling intelligent automation and decision-making grounded in real customer context.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Day AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Day AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://day.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Day AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Day AI lists 25 MCP tools, including open_sidebar, get_share_url, analyze_before_create_or_update, create_or_update_person_organization, create_or_update_opportunity, create_or_update_pipeline_stage, update_property_definition, read_crm_schema, read_object_history, search_related_objects, create_email_draft, and send_email.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Day AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Day AI in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Day AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Day AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Day AI is developed by Day AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
